fidelity.name: Fidelity Workplace Giving
fidelity.readyNote: Data Diplomats for Nonprofits is enrolled and can receive gifts here.
steps: Log in to Fidelity NetBenefits through your employer.
Open Workplace Giving and search for Data Diplomats for Nonprofits in Find Your Impact.
Choose Donate. If your employer offers a match, the platform handles the request and your employer reviews it.

stepsSource.label: Steps as one employer (CSL Behring) describes them. Yours may differ.

benevity.name: Benevity
benevity.readyNote: We are confirming our current eligibility on Benevity. Email us before giving through it, or choose another route.

employers.name: Microsoft
employers.program: Microsoft's published program matches eligible gifts 1:1 up to a combined $15,000 per employee per year, and charities must be registered with Benevity.

employers.name: Salesforce
employers.program: Salesforce publishes its employee giving and volunteering programs. We have not confirmed which portal it uses or its current match limit from Salesforce itself.

employers.name: Apple
employers.program: Apple's matching gifts guide says the program is run through Benevity and has its own eligibility rules for employees and charities.

source.label: Apple Matching Gifts Program guide (hosted by a matching-gift vendor)
